findings.title: Adapter evidence can pass without contract-test proof
findings.body: For adapter rows, `required_assertions()` returns only the PF-27 `expected` text assertions. `check_result()` treats that set as the complete proof requirement, so a `passed` adapter report can omit every `contract_tests` selector from `adapter-conformance.json` and still make the standards manifest pass. That violates this sprint's requirement that the checker require exact PF-27 native expectations and contract selectors, and it lets incomplete adapter proof become a qualification pass. Include the adapter `contract_tests` keys in the required assertion set before accepting adapter evidence.

overall_explanation: The standards checker can accept incomplete PF-27 adapter evidence as passed because adapter contract-test selectors are not required in the passing assertion set. That is a release-gating correctness issue for this harness patch.
